caveat: Workload label caveat: these runs were priced on BLIS's default 512/512-token request distribution, not on the chatbot shape this report names. `blis run --workload` is silently ignored when --concurrency is set, so every run here generated ~521/519 tokens per request instead of the preset's 256/256. The topology comparison and the per-GPU ranking are still real BLIS measurements, but they describe that default traffic -- treat the absolute throughput as being for a 256-token workload with caution. Fixed in the runner; this report predates the fix and has not been re-run.
reason: Most output tok/s on the budget while holding ≥50 tok/s/user on every instance.
